segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers report the lotion is moisturizing and non-drying, with one noting the thicker texture suits dry patches on the face.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers most often report no irritation, stinging, or breakouts and describe the formula as gentle and calming, though one reports it burned her face and had to be removed within 30 minutes.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination oily skin reports it is not shiny or matte-labeled but doesn't feel oily, aside from the white cast issue.
segments.normal: A reviewer with normal skin reports the matte, fully-dry finish is appreciated in summer.
segments.mature: One reviewer mentions using it for years without issue and links it to preventing early signs of aging, but no dedicated mature-skin commentary beyond general satisfaction.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers mention broad-spectrum protection helping prevent early signs of aging from sun exposure, but this is stated as a product claim rather than an observed change.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report the lotion moisturizes and does not dry out skin, including one who calls this 'amazing' for skin that usually dries out; no reviewer describes it as dehydrating.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the bluish-white tinge helps offset post-workout facial redness; no other redness-specific reports are present.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with eczema-prone or reactive skin report no burning or reaction, with one specifically choosing it as dermatologist-safe for psoriasis-adjacent sensitivity, though one reviewer reports it set her face on fire.
concerns.spots: Two reviewers report clearer skin or reduced breakouts (one crediting it with helping textured/acne-prone skin look smoother), while one reviewer reports a new breakout after a second application.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin report no new breakouts and credit it with helping prevent them; one dissenting reviewer reports breaking out after using it twice.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers report the formula is non-greasy, matte-finishing, and does not feel oily; no reviewer reports increased oiliness.

extraits.texte: One star, because I can't give less. I got this thinking it would be good for my very sensitive skin, but it absolutely set my face on fire. I had to go inside and get it off within 30 minutes, and the white cast is absolutely terrible. There is absolutely nothing sheer about it. It is like white paint. This is the second product like this from Cetaphil, and I will not be trying any more.

I bought this sunscreen because of how pleased I was with the other Cetaphil products I have, but to my dismay, this sunscreen is just not for me, literally. I tried it on and made sure I applied a Cetaphil moisturizer on before, but after rubbing for a couple minutes, I realized that it does not blend in well at all. The white cast is terrible on my fairly brown skin, which leads me to believe that this product was only created for a certain demographic. Even after an hour, the white cast was still noticeably present. Therefore, I truly cannot continue to use this product, although I am sure it effectively protects against skin cancer, unless, of course, the formula is improved to accommodate all people.

extraits.titre: nope, probably good for Halloween or something lol
extraits.texte: I don't understand why this have so many good reviews (and overall reviews). And why there is two identical products with different ratings (4.5 and 2.0). But nope this is just leaves white cast no matter how little u put it( and if you put it just a little it won't give as much protection). Maybe in picture I put too much but I figured it's already gives white cast, so might as well put more to not get sunburned. On the first one I put just a little and it still left white cast. And after second application I got breakout:(. So wouldn't recommend this.

I've used the Cetaphil Sheer Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 and overall I'm really impressed. I have sensitive skin, and this sunscreen feels gentle and doesn't cause any irritation or breakouts. The texture is lightweight for a mineral sunscreen and blends in fairly easily. It doesn't feel greasy or heavy, which I appreciate, especially for everyday wear. I also like that it sits well under makeup and doesn't pill. There is a slight white cast at first, but it fades as it absorbs into the skin. I feel confident knowing it's mineral-based and offers high SPF protection. Overall, it's a solid option for sensitive skin and daily sun protection, and I'd definitely recommend it.

extraits.titre: Decent Mineral Sunscreen for Senstive Skin
extraits.texte: This sunscreen is probably one of the best ones available. It's a mineral sunscreen, which is a big deciding factor for me. I keeps my skin from burning after a while out in the sun. It's good for my sensitive skin and acne prone skin as well. The only downside is that it does leave a white cast.

I am a redhead that has hypersensitive skin that reacts to just about everything and I burn easily in the sun. I used Neutrogena Sensitive Skin Sunscreen for years and they recently discontinued it. That was the only sunscreen my face used to be able to tolerate. I tried a few labeled sunscreens for sensitive skin that made me react and then finally found this one! It was a god send for someone like me. This is an awesome sunscreen that held up and I had no signs of sunburn or rashes from ingredients at all. Please don't ever stop making this.

extraits.titre: Great mineral sunscreen for sensitive skin
extraits.texte: Finally found a sunscreen which doesn't cause acne breakouts. I have sensitive skin and I wear it as a primer before applying my foundation. I have textured skin and this sunscreen makes my complexion look smooth and glowing. My friends and relatives noticed how my skin improved.
